title: Highly repulsive interaction in novel inclusion D2–N2 compound at high pressure: Raman and x-ray evidence
abstract: We present spectral and structural evidences for the formation of a homogeneous cubic δ-N2-like, noncrystalline solid and an incommensuratelike hexagonal (P6322) inclusion compound (N2)12D2, formed by compressing a nitrogen-rich mixture to 5.5 and 10 GPa, respectively. A strong repulsive coupling in (N2)12D2 is evident from a blue shift, discontinuous changes, and the absence of turnover of the D2 vibron to 70 GPa—all in sharp contrast to both pure D2 and other inclusion compounds. This repulsive interaction is responsible to the observed incommensuratelike structure and large internal pressure.
